['Altana AG '].company_description: Altana AG (styled as ALTANA) is a German chemical company headquartered in Wesel. It was created in 1977, as a result of spinning off divisions from the Varta Group. The group comprises the divisions BYK (coating additives and instruments), Eckart (metal effect pigments and metallic printing inks), Elantas (insulation materials for the electrical and electronics industries) and Actega (coatings and sealant compounds for the packaging industry). The Altana Group has 48 production facilities and 63 service and research laboratories worldwide. In 2022, the company, with about 7,000 employees, posted revenues of over €3 billion.

['Dow Deutschland Anlagengesellschaft mb.company_description: Dow Deutschland Anlagengesellschaft mbH operates within the Marl Chemical Park, an industrial park in Marl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany. The park hosts 100 chemical plants, employs 10,000 people, and produces 4 million metric tons of chemicals annually. Dow Deutschland Anlagengesellschaft mbH is one of the companies based in the park.
